vision.title: Win-Win Community in the Agent Era
vision_points: Reading a paper means more than highlighting: what problem it solves, how solid the evidence is, where it breaks down — and you can explain all that to someone else.
What you learn has to land in code. It only counts once you have run it yourself and hit the snags.
When stuck, bring the problem to the community — someone has usually hit the same wall.
offerings: A full Agent curriculum: from RAG and memory to multi-agent and Code Agent, ten stages in a row
Weekly code review and retros — someone goes through your project with you, every week
A growing interview question collection: what gets asked, how to approach it, where the traps are
Every project on your resume is something you actually built
vision.bottom_note: When the round is done, the GitHub repo, the paper and the retro notes are all there to show.
